The Global Smaller Companies Trust plc
Extension of multicurrency revolving loan facility

The Company advises that it has extended the maturity date of its existing unsecured multicurrency revolving loan facility of up to £35,000,000 with The Royal Bank of Scotland International Limited, London Branch from 11 September 2026 to 10 September 2027.
